name: Quickfisco
author: quickfiscodev

sections.description:
The Quickfisco plugin connects your WooCommerce store to the Quickfisco fees register and automates fiscal management of sales. The plugin imports orders, refunds and returns, processes them according to Italian regulations and automatically generates daily and monthly fees records. Designed for professionals, physical stores and online businesses under the flat-rate tax regime who want to synchronize revenue while avoiding errors and manual tasks.

Key Features

  • Automatic import: WooCommerce orders are synchronised in real-time
  • Simple and fast setup: connect Quickfisco to your WooCommerce store in a few clicks
  • Multi-payment support: compatible with all WooCommerce payment methods including credit cards, PayPal, bank transfers, cash on delivery and more
  • Returns and refunds management: automatic synchronisation of returns, refunds (full and partial) and cancellations with fees register updates
  • ATECO code management: easy configuration and management of ATECO codes for proper categorization
  • Tax Authority compliance: registration compliant with Italian Revenue Agency requirements through Quickfisco fiscal software
  • No manual intervention: the plugin handles everything automatically
sections.installation:
1. The Quickfisco plugin requires “WooCommerce” to be activated. Make sure you have it installed.
  2. Search for the “Quickfisco” plugin in the official WordPress Directory through the “Plugin” section of your Admin Panel
  3. Install the plugin and activate it clicking on the “Activate Plugin” button
  4. In Settings, click on Quickfisco to access the configuration page.
  5. Enter the API Token previously generated on the Quickfisco platform.
  6. Select the ATECO Code for which you want to synchronize the fees register.
  7. Save the settings. The setup is now complete!
sections.faq:
Do I need a Quickfisco account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need an active Quickfisco account and API token to use this plugin. The plugin connects to Quickfisco services to process your order data.

What happens if WooCommerce is deactivated?

The plugin will detect if WooCommerce is not active and will not process any orders. It will log a notice that WooCommerce is not detected. Simply reactivate WooCommerce to resume functionality.

Which order statuses trigger the Quickfisco integration?

The plugin monitors several order status changes:
– Payment completion for online payments (cards, PayPal, etc.)
– Orders moving from “processing” to “completed” through your Admin Panel
– Orders moving from “on-hold” to “completed” through your Admin Panel
– Orders created directly as “completed” through your Admin Panel

How are refunds handled?

The plugin automatically detects both full and partial refunds and sends the appropriate data to Quickfisco services. This ensures your records stay synchronised.

Can I disable the plugin temporarily?

Yes, you can disable the plugin through the settings page without deactivating it entirely. This allows you to pause the integration while keeping your configuration intact.

What data is sent to Quickfisco?

The plugin sends order information required for fee registration and compliance. All data transmission follows privacy guidelines and only sends necessary business data.

Is the plugin available in Italian?

Yes, the plugin includes full Italian localisation and can be used in Italian WordPress installations.
